card.text: TOI-2257 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-2257 b"
sources.quote: TOI-2257 b is an extremely eccentric (0.496) exoplanet in or near the circumstellar habitable zone of the star TOI-2257, 188 light-years away.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around TOI-2257. Its orbit and size follow Schanche et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-2257 b"
sources.quote: It is likely a sub-Neptune exoplanet, with a mass of 5.71 M🜨 and a radius of 2.19 R🜨.
